_comment: Per-scenario median-wall base budgets for the wasi-microbench host-path regression detector (#583, W11-6). Calibrated 2026-07-15 from 98 retained ubuntu-22.04 x86_64 artifact reports (2026-06-06 through 2026-07-14). The default +10% threshold turns these base values into effective gates of roughly the observed run-median mean + 2 sample standard deviations; it is not extra margin on top of a +2-sigma budget. Methodology: docs/wasi.md § 'Updating the wasi-microbench budget'.
